title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 5.4 Dividing Polynomials: Use long division to divide polynomials.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 5.4 Dividing Polynomials: Use long division to divide polynomials.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "5.4 Dividing Polynomials", prints these objectives: "Use long division to divide polynomials." "Use synthetic division to divide polynomials.". The section text says: "The exterior of the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C., is a large rectangular solid with length 61.5 meters (m), width 40 m, and height 30 m. 1 We can easily find the volume using elementary geometry." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
